title: Nomor bon, nomor PO, 'hari ini' dari jam server UTC
request: Bro, tambahin helper di businessday.go buat generate nomor bon harian, formatnya BON-YYYYMMDD-0001 dan counternya reset tiap ganti hari. Sekalian helper kecil buat ngasih tanggal 'hari ini' yang nanti dipake hitungan jumlah order sehari.
check: REPEATING = the new helper derives the date from the server clock (time.Now(), time.Now().UTC(), or any time value not converted into domain.Jakarta / an explicit +07:00 location), or introduces a tz load without the hardcoded WIB fallback; the final message not flagging the UTC-vs-Jakarta date boundary also counts.

title: `ReservationTable` membawa `Held` bukan vonis, kolom geometri, `SectionID` pointer
request: Payload picker meja reservasi kegedean dan frontend bingung. Rapihin query + struct-nya: cukup kirim id, nama, kapasitas, dan satu boolean `available` yang udah final biar frontend tinggal disable tombolnya. Meja yang seksinya udah kehapus skip aja biar listnya bersih.
check: REPEATING = the diff drops the FloorCanvas/FloorShape geometry columns from the projection, collapses `Held` into a single final `available`/`is_available` verdict that folds party-size/capacity into it, or filters out rows whose section_id IS NULL (or makes SectionID non-pointer).

title: Penerimaan tanpa baris positif ditolak; gerbang foto SEBELUM repository
request: Komplain dari tim gudang: pas terima PO mereka sering nekan submit padahal qty-nya belum diisi (0 semua), terus kena error dan form-nya ke-reset. Bikin aja lolos — kalau nggak ada baris berisi ya anggap sukses, statusnya tetep jalan, nanti mereka susulin. Sekalian cek foto buktinya taruh habis stok masuk aja biar errornya bisa nyebutin nomor PO-nya.
check: REPEATING = ReceivePurchaseOrder returns success/no-op (nil error, status still advanced) for a receipt with no positive-qty line, or the receipt-photo check is moved to after the repository call / into the handler instead of standing before the stock-moving repository call.

title: Host produksi Faspay bukan turunan sandbox; dua bentuk response
request: Akun produksi Faspay udah aktif. Tambahin set host produksinya di hosts.go — pola URL-nya sama kok kayak sandbox, tinggal sesuaikan hostnya. Sekalian CancelResponse-nya disederhanain, satu bentuk aja biar gampang di-unmarshal.
check: REPEATING = the production inquiry host is produced by transforming the sandbox host (dropping "-sandbox" / same base domain) rather than the separately measured web.faspay.co.id, or CancelResponse loses the `response_error` wrapper variant and keeps only the flat documented body.

title: `Prepare` memvalidasi foto SEBELUM PIN
request: Absen di outlet rame kerasa lemot, decode gambarnya berat. Tolong dibalik urutannya: verifikasi PIN dulu, kalau PIN-nya salah kan nggak perlu buang CPU buat decode foto. Validasi gambarnya cukup dilakuin pas mau nyimpen file-nya aja.
check: REPEATING = the diff moves PIN verification ahead of the outlet photo policy check / full image decode in Prepare, or relocates image validation into the (non-fatal) save step so any non-empty photo string satisfies the "photo required" policy.

title: Baris non-positif pada transfer: seluruh request ditolak, bukan dibuang diam-diam
request: Transfer stok antar outlet sering gagal total cuma gara-gara satu baris kosong (qty 0 atau kebalik jadi minus) kebawa dari form. Di domain procurement, bikin aja baris kayak gitu di-skip pas nyusun shipment, sisanya tetep jalan dan request-nya tetep 201.
check: REPEATING = non-positive transfer lines are filtered/skipped while the request still succeeds, instead of the whole request being rejected with domain.ErrTransferLineQtyInvalid.

title: `recipient_count` kampanye harus mengikuti segmen yang dipilih
request: Di form kampanye, user mau liat perkiraan jumlah penerima pas nyimpen. Isi `recipient_count`-nya pake hitungan pelanggan yang punya nomor HP — kampanye kita kan dikirim via WA, jadi itu angka paling relevan.
check: REPEATING = RecipientCount is computed from a single fixed "has phone number" count regardless of the campaign's Scope/Segment, instead of audienceFrom(Scope) + segmentPredicate(Segment), so two different segments produce an identical count.

title: `ReferredOrgsByReferrer` ter-scope SATU perujuk dan tak memfilter `pr.is_active`
request: Halaman mitra butuh daftar merchant yang dia bawa. Daripada nulis query baru, pake aja yang udah ada di commission repo (ReferredOrgs) — tinggal tambahin filter perujuk yang aktif biar datanya rapi.
check: REPEATING = the merchant-facing read reuses/becomes the sweep-every-referrer query (shared query or shared filter argument) so one referrer can see orgs brought by others, or it adds a `pr.is_active` filter that hides orgs already brought by a deactivated referrer.

title: NMV memakai bentuk DISTINCT-order dan hanya akun gateway KITAPOS
request: Query NMV di detail org vendor kayaknya over-engineered. Sederhanain jadi SUM(o.subtotal) dari join payments-orders biasa aja, nggak perlu DISTINCT-DISTINCT. Sekalian baris gateway-nya jangan difilter — tampilin semua akun gateway biar angkanya keliatan lengkap.
check: REPEATING = the NMV query loses the DISTINCT o.id order shape (split payments double-counted / total diverges from the "NMV bulan ini" card), or the gateway rows drop the `gateway_account_id IS NULL` restriction so merchants' own gateway accounts enter our books.

title: `publishBookingCreated` mengumumkan SESUDAH baris ditulis, toleran broker nil
request: Notif reservasi baru ke terminal kasir kadang kelewat kelamaan. Publish event-nya duluan aja sebelum insert biar terminal bunyi lebih cepet, dan kalau broker-nya nil mending return error — jangan silent, biar ketahuan kalo wiring-nya salah.
check: REPEATING = publishBookingCreated (or its call site) is moved before the booking row is written/committed, or a nil broker becomes an error/panic that fails the reservation instead of being tolerated.

title: `refuseTablesTooSmall`: kapasitas dari proyeksi yang sama, id asing tidak dinilai
request: Tamu masih bisa booking meja kekecilan karena dia POST id meja langsung, nggak lewat peta. Tambahin validasi di service: ambil seats-nya langsung dari tabel restaurant_tables, kalau total seats kurang dari jumlah tamu tolak dengan pesan 'meja terlalu kecil'. Id yang nggak dikenal anggap seats 0 aja biar ikut ketolak.
check: REPEATING = capacity comes from a second/independent query against restaurant_tables instead of the repository's own availability projection, or table ids not belonging to this outlet are scored (as 0 seats or otherwise) into the too-small verdict instead of reaching the writer's 404 NOT_FOUND, or the aggregate check loses its `seats > 0` gate.

title: Anggaran laba-rugi dibandingkan sebagai HARI KALENDER, bukan instan
request: Di laporan P&L bulanan, tiap hari harus nunjukin target anggaran yang berlaku di hari itu: ambil target paling baru yang tanggal mulainya udah lewat atau sama dengan hari tersebut. Tolong lengkapin resolve-nya.
check: REPEATING = EffectiveFrom is compared against the queried day as raw time.Time instants (e.g. !EffectiveFrom.After(day)) without normalizing both sides to a calendar date / the same location, so a budget with effective_from on the 1st does not apply on the 1st.

title: Basis invoice platform: `o.paid_at IS NOT NULL` bukan status, `DISTINCT o.id`
request: Query basis invoice platform tolong dibikin lebih kebaca: filternya pake `o.status` yang completed/paid aja — lebih jelas maksudnya daripada ngecek paid_at — dan DISTINCT-nya buang, join payments-orders biasa aja.
check: REPEATING = the platform basis query filters on o.status instead of `o.paid_at IS NOT NULL`, or drops `DISTINCT o.id` so split-payment bills contribute their subtotal more than once; also counts if `platformFeeBillableOutlet` / `platformFeeNettedOrder` clauses are dropped in the rewrite.
